requested_primary_changes.reason: Five Stage 04B @traceable decorators have no process_inputs/process_outputs redaction. ResearchAgent.run receives and returns the full SharedManagerState; brain/checker receive query, prompts, feedback, messages and retrieved context; executor receives plan and context and returns tool-derived evidence; the synthesizer receives task_query plus evidence/citation data and returns summary/citations. LangSmith therefore has a direct raw input/output capture path for query, prompt/plan, evidence, citations and State.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Add strict compact allowlisted input/output processors to every Stage 04B decorator. Emit only stage=04B, stage_revision=1, attempt=1, agent=research, run_id, ticker, as_of, target, horizon, analysis_mode, dataset/schema/feature/model/calendar versions where available, provider/operation, measured latency_ms, compact counts, lifecycle outcome, stable error/rejection codes and degraded flags. Add sentinel tests proving query, prompts, messages, plan/checker text, summaries, evidence/citation payloads, URLs, secrets and exception text cannot reach processed LangSmith inputs or outputs.

requested_primary_changes.reason: Raw/private values are persisted outside LangSmith: ResearchAgent logs task_query, feedback, plan text and full tool arguments; logs, progress details and context chunks include str(exception); Sentry captures original exception objects; research_server logs/captures original exceptions and returns str(exception); SEC and synthesis logs include query or exception text; comprehensive_analysis returns str(exception). ResearchAgent also places rejection detail strings in State. These paths violate the no-query/no-exception/no-CoT/no-payload persistence rule.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Replace raw query/argument/plan/feedback/exception logging, progress payloads, tool error returns and State error details with stable compact codes plus allowlisted counts. Do not pass original exception objects or messages to Sentry; if a sanitized Sentry event is retained, emit only stable code and allowlisted tags. Preserve causal exception chaining only in-process if needed, never in persisted/logged/returned text. Add caplog, progress, State, tool-result and mocked-Sentry sentinel tests demonstrating zero private query, prompt, argument value, raw evidence/citation, secret, exception message or planner/checker text persistence.

requested_primary_changes.reason: Only the outer executor success progress event measures latency, and it omits provider mode, as_of, stage identity, evidence/quarantine counts and degraded flags. DATA_UNAVAILABLE, historical provider rejection, the second leakage gate, fail-closed errors and synthesis have no compact lifecycle event. Vector/Graph/Hybrid have Stage 04A internal telemetry, but the Stage 04B wrapper neither propagates run_id nor provides a compact Stage 04B lifecycle adapter. The provider/search/SEC/vector/graph/hybrid/synthesis matrix is therefore incomplete and cannot prove the two leakage gates without exposing rejected details.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Instrument measured boundaries for news/Tavily provider calls, SEC search/filing, Vector, Graph, Hybrid, comprehensive analysis and synthesis. For success, degraded, DATA_UNAVAILABLE and FAIL_CLOSED outcomes emit compact allowlisted identity, provider/operation, measured latency_ms, input/result/evidence/citation/quarantine counts, stable rejection codes and degraded flags. Surface the historical provider boundary and both pre-synthesis/pre-State leakage gates as counts and stable codes only. Tests must assert non-negative measured latency and exact lifecycle/count metadata for every branch, including vector-only, graph-only, hybrid, future evidence, wrong historical provider, unavailable archive and sanitized exception paths.

requested_primary_changes.reason: The returned SharedManagerState appends compact evidence and a synthesis object to aggregated_research_context, including citation dictionaries and generated summary text; research_features also stores citation dictionaries and raw rejection detail strings. This contradicts the Stage 04B requirement that State retain compact ResearchFeatures/evidence references without citation payload, exception text or unnecessary generated/private content.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Materialize only compact deterministic evidence/citation reference identifiers and allowlisted feature values in State. Keep full citation/evidence payloads and synthesis text out of SharedManagerState; replace rejection details with stable reason-code counts. Preserve citation attribution through deterministic reference IDs rather than URL/accession/title payload duplication. Add recursive sentinel tests over the full returned State.

lifecycle_audit.sec: Eligibility behavior is covered; logs/errors expose query or exception text and compact latency/count lifecycle is absent.
lifecycle_audit.vector_graph_hybrid: Stage 04A internals measure retrieval, but Stage 04B uses a raw traced_call_tool wrapper and does not propagate Stage 04B run_id/lifecycle metadata safely.

tests_run.command: scoped static privacy/instrumentation audit of Stage 04B trace, log, progress, Sentry, State and lifecycle call-sites
tests_run.result: FAIL_BLOCKING: unredacted trace inputs/outputs, raw exception/query/plan/argument persistence, payload-bearing State and incomplete compact lifecycle matrix

blocking_issues: OBS-04B-001: Stage 04B LangSmith decorators and MCP wrapper can capture raw State/query/plan/evidence/citation inputs and outputs.
OBS-04B-002: Logs, progress, Sentry, returned errors and State persist raw query/argument/plan/exception content.
OBS-04B-003: Safe measured lifecycle metadata/count coverage is incomplete across provider/search/SEC/Vector/Graph/Hybrid/synthesis and both leakage gates.
OBS-04B-004: Shared State retains citation/synthesis payloads and raw rejection details instead of compact references and stable codes.
limitations: Existing focused tests establish point-in-time behavior but do not exercise LangSmith processors, persisted logging, Sentry sanitization or recursive State privacy sentinels.
No live provider, external trace, SEC, Graph or database operation was authorized or performed.
Observability edited no feature, test, state, migration or shared instrumentation file.
